components.name: ME Attribute

description.short: Create or modify Meanders object attributes.
description.long: Creates a new Meanders attribute object or modifies an existing ME Attribute or Rhino ObjectAttributes instance. The component supports object name, layer assignment, object color, and Rhino user text key-value pairs.

inputs.name: Existing Attributes
inputs.description: Existing ME Attribute or Rhino ObjectAttributes to modify.

inputs.name: Keys
inputs.description: User text keys.

inputs.name: Values
inputs.description: User text values corresponding to the supplied keys.

inputs.name: Name
inputs.description: Rhino object name.

inputs.name: Layer
inputs.description: Full Rhino layer path to assign to the object attributes.

inputs.name: Object Color
inputs.description: Object display color stored in the Rhino object attributes.

outputs.name: Keys
outputs.description: User text keys stored in the resulting attributes.

outputs.name: Values
outputs.description: User text values stored in the resulting attributes.

outputs.name: Name
outputs.description: Object name stored in the resulting attributes.

outputs.name: Layer
outputs.description: Full Rhino layer path stored in the resulting attributes.

outputs.name: Object Color
outputs.description: Object color stored in the resulting attributes.

errors: Existing Attributes must be ME Attribute or Rhino ObjectAttributes.
Keys and Values must have the same number of items.

examples.title: Create fabrication attributes
examples.description: Create attributes with a name, layer, object color, and user text for later attachment to geometry.

notes: Layer assignment requires an active Rhino document.
Existing attributes are duplicated before changes are applied.
Keys and Values must contain the same number of items.

components.name: ME Fab Text

description.long: Creates fabrication-ready text curves on a plane using the Meanders fabrication glyph library. Supported characters are converted directly to lightweight geometric curves. Fabrication markers can be embedded in the text using AR tokens for directional arrows and EG tokens for edge-banding markers.

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.description: Plane used to place the fabrication text. Defaults to the World XY plane.

inputs.name: Text
inputs.description: Fabrication text containing supported characters and optional AR or EG markers.

inputs.name: Text Size
inputs.description: Height of the text. Default is 1.

inputs.name: Justification
inputs.description: Text justification. 0=Bottom Left, 1=Bottom Center, 2=Bottom Right, 3=Middle Left, 4=Middle Center, 5=Middle Right, 6=Top Left, 7=Top Center, 8=Top Right. Default is Middle Center. The same options are also available from the component context menu.

inputs.name: Spacing
inputs.description: Additional spacing between character slots. The default value is the minimum spacing.

errors: Unsupported characters produce an error identifying the unsupported character and its position in the input text.
Text Size must be greater than zero.

examples.title: Basic fabrication text
examples.description: Create simple fabrication text from supported characters.

examples.title: Directional arrows
examples.description: Insert directional arrows into the text. Each AR marker occupies one character slot and the angle is measured in degrees relative to the local X axis of the text Plane.

examples.title: Full edge marker
examples.description: Insert a square edge-banding marker with all four edges visible.

examples.title: Partial edge marker
examples.description: Insert a square edge-banding marker with selected edges omitted. EG-NT removes the top edge.

notes: Normal characters are generated from the Meanders fabrication glyph library.
Only characters available in the fabrication glyph library are supported.
Each normal character participates as one character in the text layout.
AR markers use the format <AR-angle>, for example <AR-45> or <AR-195>.
The AR angle is measured in degrees relative to the local X axis of the text Plane.
Each AR marker occupies one character slot.
EG markers use the format <EG-flag>.
EG-F displays all four edges of the square marker.
EG-BR displays the Bottom and Right edges.
EG-TR displays the Top and Right edges.
EG-TL displays the Top and Left edges.
EG-BL displays the Bottom and Left edges.
EG-NB displays all edges except Bottom.
EG-NR displays all edges except Right.
EG-NT displays all edges except Top.
EG-NL displays all edges except Left.
Each EG marker occupies one character slot.
Spacing adds distance between character slots and cannot be negative.
Justification can be supplied through the J input or selected from the component context menu.
The default justification is Middle Center.
The default Text Size is 1.
The default Spacing is the minimum spacing.

components.name: ME Attach Attribute

description.short: Attach Meanders attributes to geometry or Grasshopper data.
description.long: Creates ME Object instances by combining geometry or supported Grasshopper data with Meanders attributes while preserving the geometry input tree structure.

inputs.name: Geometry
inputs.description: Geometry or supported Grasshopper data to combine with Meanders attributes.

inputs.name: Attributes
inputs.description: ME Attribute or Rhino ObjectAttributes to attach to the supplied geometry.

outputs.name: ME Objects
outputs.description: ME Object instances containing geometry and attached attributes.

examples.title: Attach one attribute set to multiple geometry items
examples.description: Use a single attribute item with a geometry branch; the last available attribute is reused for remaining geometry items.

notes: Geometry tree paths are preserved.
If an attribute branch is shorter than the geometry branch, the last available attribute is reused.
If no attributes are supplied, default empty object attributes are used.

components.name: ME Detach Geometry

description.short: Detach geometry and attributes from Meanders objects.
description.long: Separates ME Object instances into their stored geometry and Meanders attributes while preserving the original Grasshopper data tree paths.

inputs.name: ME Objects
inputs.description: Meanders objects to separate into geometry and attributes.

outputs.name: Geometry
outputs.description: Geometry stored inside each ME Object.

outputs.name: Attributes
outputs.description: Meanders attributes stored inside each ME Object.

examples.title: Recover geometry and attributes
examples.description: Detach geometry and attributes from objects previously created with ME Attach Attribute.

notes: Input tree paths are preserved.
Null ME Objects are skipped.
The input objects are not modified.

components.name: ME Round Number

description.short: Round numbers to a specified number of decimal places.
description.long: Rounds one or more numbers to a specified number of decimal places. Values exactly halfway between two results are rounded away from zero.

inputs.name: Number
inputs.description: Numbers to round.

inputs.name: Decimal Places
inputs.description: Number of decimal places to keep.

errors: Decimal Places must be between 0 and 15.
Number cannot contain NaN or Infinity.

examples.title: Round to two decimal places
examples.description: Round a number to two decimal places.

examples.title: Round multiple numbers
examples.description: Round a list of numbers using the same decimal-place setting.

examples.title: Halfway values
examples.description: Values exactly halfway between two results are rounded away from zero.

notes: Decimal Places defaults to 2.
Decimal Places must be an integer between 0 and 15.
Rounding uses MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero.
The Number input accepts a list of numbers.

components.name: ME Round to Odd/Even

description.short: Round numbers to the nearest odd or even integer.
description.long: Rounds one or more numbers to the nearest integer with a specified odd or even parity. Mode 0 selects an even result and Mode 1 selects an odd result.

inputs.name: Number
inputs.description: Numbers to round to the nearest integer with the requested parity.

inputs.name: Mode
inputs.description: Requested integer parity. 0 = Even, 1 = Odd. If the list is shorter than Number, its last value is repeated.

outputs.name: Rounded
outputs.description: Numbers rounded to the nearest integer with the requested odd or even parity.

errors: Number cannot contain NaN or Infinity.

examples.title: Round to even
examples.description: Round numbers to the nearest even integer.

examples.title: Round to odd
examples.description: Round numbers to the nearest odd integer.

examples.title: Mode list with Repeat Last
examples.description: When the Mode list is shorter than Number, the last Mode value is repeated. Extra Mode values are ignored.

notes: Mode 0 means Even.
Mode 1 means Odd.
Number is the master list and determines the number of output items.
If Mode contains fewer items than Number, the last Mode value is repeated.
If Mode contains more items than Number, extra Mode values are ignored.
The output always contains the same number of items as the Number input.
For values exactly halfway between two valid integers, the nearest valid integer is selected according to the requested parity.
The Number input accepts a list of numbers.

components.name: ME Unit Converter

description.short: Convert values between supported length units.
description.long: Converts numerical length values between millimeters, centimeters, meters, inches, and feet. Source unit, target unit, and conversion direction are controlled from the component context menu.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.description: Numeric length value to convert.

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: Converted length value in the selected target unit.

notes: The component currently supports length units only.
Context menu settings are stored inside the Grasshopper document.

components.name: ME Bake

description.short: Bake geometry into Rhino with Meanders attributes.
description.long: Bakes geometry or ME Objects into the active Rhino document. A Meanders Attribute can be supplied and defaults to an empty ME Attribute. The Bake input is true by default, and a Bake button is also available directly on the component. When Group branch items is enabled, which is the default, baked objects from each Grasshopper branch are placed into a Rhino group.

inputs.name: Geometry
inputs.description: Geometry or ME Objects to bake.

inputs.name: Attribute
inputs.description: Meanders attributes to apply while baking. Defaults to an empty ME Attribute.

inputs.name: Bake
inputs.description: When true, bake the supplied geometry during solution. Defaults to true.

examples.title: Bake branch geometry
examples.description: With Group branch items enabled, each Grasshopper branch is baked into its own Rhino group.

notes: The Bake input defaults to true.
An empty ME Attribute is used when no attribute is supplied.
The Bake button on the component bakes the current input data independently of the Bake input value.
Group branch items is enabled by default and can be changed from the component context menu.
The component outputs a text message rather than baked geometry.

parameters.name: ME Attribute

description.long: A Grasshopper parameter for storing and passing Meanders Attribute data.

notes: The parameter currently does not provide an interactive prompt.
The parameter stores ME Attribute data.

parameters.name: ME Object

description.long: A Grasshopper parameter for storing, previewing, and baking Meanders Object data.

notes: The parameter supports Grasshopper tree access.
The parameter supports viewport preview.
The parameter supports baking Meanders objects into the Rhino document.
